description:
The Huffy Disney Princess Light-Up 3-Wheel Scooter turns every ride into a fairytale journey. With beloved Disney Princess graphics, shimmering accents, and a glitter-infused deck, little riders can bring their favorite storybook adventures to life while enjoying active outdoor fun.
A dazzling deck illuminated by 42 LED lights creates a colorful display of pink, purple, and white lights that glow as kids ride. The sparkling effect adds excitement to every sidewalk adventure, making each glide feel a little more magical and memorable.
The stable 3-wheel design helps young riders build balance and confidence as they learn. A lightweight frame, wide deck, and easy-to-grip handlebars are sized just for small hands, while the durable steel frame and smooth PVC wheels provide lasting fun ride after ride. Quick Connect assembly gets the adventure started in minutes.
